exceptions.reason: `Meter.test.ts` tests the ARIA attributes of the root, the value in the range, the text with `format`, `locale` and `getAriaValueText`, the element slot and the name.

exceptions.title: formats with en-US until hydrated, then with the runtime locale
exceptions.reason: With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser (VUE-170). The server HTML and the first render of the browser then agree.
`Meter.test.ts` tests the name that the label gives, a change of its `id`, its unmount and the error outside a root.
`Meter.test.ts` tests the text of the value, the default slot with `formattedValue` and `value`, and the element slot.

exceptions.title: accepts a render function
exceptions.reason: The default slot of `Meter.Value` takes the place of the `children` function, and the `element` slot gets the same `formattedValue` and `value`. The case "the default slot of Meter.Value gets the text and the value prop, and follows a change" tests it.

exceptions.title: hydrates $name without a mismatch, then uses the runtime locale
exceptions.reason: With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, on the server and in the browser, so it does not change after the hydration (VUE-170). The case of VUE-170 hydrates `Meter.Value` with no message. The value reads its text from the root, so a value in `<Suspense>` needs no case of its own.
`Meter.test.ts` tests the element of the track, its attributes and its element slot.
`Meter.test.ts` tests the width of the indicator for each value of the range, its start edge in each text direction and a `style` of the developer.
An ARIA attribute is a plain attribute of the root, not a prop. It reaches the element with the other attributes, and it wins over the text of the part.

The state of the root is `{}`, so a state type and a `state` slot prop give the developer nothing. With no `locale`, the text has the locale of the nearest `LocaleProvider`, else `en-US`, and not the locale of the browser, so that the server HTML and the first render of the browser agree.
The state of the value is `{}`, so a state type and a `state` slot prop give the developer nothing.
The state of the indicator is `{}`, so a state type and a `state` slot prop give the developer nothing.
The state of the track is `{}`, so a state type and a `state` slot prop give the developer nothing.
The state of the label is `{}`, so a state type and a `state` slot prop give the developer nothing.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the root for `aria-labelledby`, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the label, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

relocations.behavior: The root writes the role, the values, the text of the value and the name.
The value shows the text of the root.
The indicator has the width of the percent of the value.
